summary.es: Torresella Pinot Grigio es un vino blanco de Torresella, con la denominación DOC Pinot Grigio Delle Venezie, en Italia.
summary.en: Torresella Pinot Grigio is a white wine from Torresella, made under the DOC Pinot Grigio Delle Venezie appellation in Italy.
